# Dawid Szymanowski

> Dawid Szymanowski is a researcher (Oberassistent) in the Institute of Geochemistry and Petrology at ETH Zürich. He works on high-precision U–Pb geochronology and zircon petrochronology: the assembly, storage and eruption of large silicic magma reservoirs; ID-TIMS methods and interlaboratory reproducibility; reference materials for in situ (including carbonate) dating; large igneous provinces; ore deposits; and lunar chronology.
